zh: 删除链表中的若干节点不会改变其余节点的相对顺序，所以结果就是原序列中所有值不超过 x 的节点。
按原顺序扫描节点值，只保留 ≤x 的，跳过 >x 的；这相当于把被删节点的前驱直接接到它的后继上。
读入 n、x 和 n 个值；依次判断每个值，值 ≤x 就加入输出（等于 x 的要保留），否则跳过；最后用空格连接输出，全部被删时输出空行，不要输出节点个数。
en: Deleting some nodes of a linked list does not change the relative order of the others, so the result is exactly the nodes whose value is at most x, in the original order.
Scan the values in order, keeping those <= x and skipping those > x; this is the same as linking each deleted node's predecessor straight to its successor.

Read n, x and the n values; test each value in turn and append it to the output when it is <= x (values equal to x stay), skipping it otherwise; print the kept values separated by spaces, an empty line if everything was deleted, and never the node count.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Read the nodes in order and output only those whose value does not exceed x; in a linked-list implementation this is equivalent to pointing each deleted node's predecessor at its successor.

## Proof of correctness

Every node with a value greater than x is skipped exactly once, and every other node is output exactly once; the order from head to tail is unchanged, so the result is exactly the list after deleting the target nodes.

## Complexity

O(n) time, O(n) output buffer.
